text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, several boxes of fan mail<n>arrive at the
academy, all addressed<n>to Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm... at a loss for words.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: We have some time today before<n>training, I believe.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind if I read through<n>these in the
meantime?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate it. These letters deserve<n>my full
attention.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As we Umamusume race in the<n>Twinkle Series, we
inspire dreams in<n>the hearts of the fans who watch
us.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And in turn, their support becomes the<n>wind at our
back, urging us ever<n>onward in pursuit of our own
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That cycle is something I cherish<n>dearly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I wish to carry all my fans' support<n>with me as I
move forward.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: To me, that is part of being an<n>Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
From the earnestness with which<n>Symboli Rudolf
sits down to read, it's<n>clear that she truly treasures
her<n>fans.
